title: Glide Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: GlideOS is fast for internal business apps built from spreadsheets, but it no longer targets store-published mobile apps and prices by members and credits. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform.
body_markdown: Not mentioned: its current pricing and product pages describe internal business apps and do not cover App Store or Google Play publishing. Blink builds and signs native apps in the cloud and sends iOS builds to TestFlight.
